tables.name: _cf_KV
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE _cf_KV (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value BLOB
      ) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: binding_events
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE binding_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, provider TEXT NOT NULL, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, old_root TEXT, new_root TEXT, at INTEGER NOT NULL, details TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: collection_backups
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE collection_backups (backup_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: controller_state
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE controller_state (state_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_run INTEGER NOT NULL, candidates_seen INTEGER NOT NULL, rebinds INTEGER NOT NULL, duplicates_removed INTEGER NOT NULL, ambiguous INTEGER NOT NULL, errors TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: provider_bindings
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE provider_bindings (provider TEXT PRIMARY KEY, current_root TEXT NOT NULL, previous_root TEXT, expected_host TEXT NOT NULL, expected_manifest_id TEXT, expected_manifest_name TEXT, current_version TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_validated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
